coherence_rules: Product version is always 0.0.1 Beta until an owner-approved version policy changes it.
Implementation generations and document revisions must never be presented as product maturity.
A repository may have only one canonical role and at most one current source-of-truth claim.
A public claim must reference current PUBLIC_PRESENT evidence and freshness.
Historical or superseded work remains preserved but must not appear as active roadmap work.
A release unit must declare owner, dependencies, next action, rollback, reality, maturity, and evidence state.
Conflicting claims fail closed and enter the contradiction ledger.
Local runtime evidence outranks stale GitHub prose for runtime facts; reviewed GitHub contracts outrank memory for public protocol facts.
